question.name: Question 7
question.problem: Calculate the derivative of  $f(t)=⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡t,\,\operatorname{ln}⁡t,\,{t}^{2}⟩$ with respect to $t.$
question.worked_solution:
We find the derivative of $f(t)$ by differentiating each component:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(t) & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{cos}⁡t),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{ln}⁡t),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({t}^{2})⟩ \\  & =⟨-\operatorname{sin}⁡t,\,\frac{1}{t},\,2t⟩\end{aligned}
$$
